title: Lots of fun!
text: Lots of fun!. Ok, I stink at cake decorating, but it was still a lot of fun.  The pan is great and the colors are pretty.  If I had the hand for this, my cake would have been great. I love that everything is included for decorating.  You won't be disappointed.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Non-Stick Easter Bunny Cake Baking and Decorating Set, 5-Piece
features: Bake and decorate a cute bunny cake for your Easter table with this set
Includes bunny cake pan, pastel nonpareils, 3 pouches of Decorating Icing with round and star tips
Bunny pan made of steel; non-stick for easy release and quick cleanup
Easter bunny cake pan measures approximately 12 x 8 x 2 in
Pan is top rack dishwasher safe; best results, hand wash in warm, soapy water after each use
